BOARD MEETING MINUTES
Marbledock & Associates
Date: January 12, 2025
Location: Executive Conference Room, Marbledock & Associates Headquarters
Meeting called to order at: 9:00 AM
Meeting adjourned at: 11:45 AM

ATTENDEES:
- Margaret Holvan, Chief Executive Officer (Chair)
- Pierre Dubois, Chief Financial Officer
- Aiyana Park, Head of Operations

RECORDER: Clara Sievert, Executive Assistant

---

AGENDA ITEM 1: APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES

Margaret Holvan opened the meeting and called for a review of the minutes from the previous board meeting held on December 8, 2024. Pierre Dubois noted a minor correction to the Q4 budget figures referenced in item three of those minutes. Following the correction, the minutes were reviewed and approved unanimously.

DECISION: Minutes from December 8, 2024 approved as amended, with correction to Q4 budget figures.

---

AGENDA ITEM 2: Q4 2024 FINANCIAL REVIEW AND 2025 BUDGET OUTLOOK

Pierre Dubois presented the Q4 2024 financial results. Revenue for Q4 came in at $4.2 million, representing a 7% increase year-over-year. Net operating margin stood at 18.3%, slightly above the projected 17.5%. Total annual revenue for 2024 reached $15.8 million. Dubois highlighted that operating costs were brought under control following the renegotiation of vendor contracts in October 2024.

For 2025, Dubois proposed a working budget reflecting a 10% revenue growth target, bringing the projected annual revenue to approximately $17.4 million. He recommended increasing the technology infrastructure budget by $300,000 to support ongoing digital transformation initiatives and proposed a 5% contingency reserve fund.

Discussion followed regarding the allocation of funds for potential new hires in the client services division. Aiyana Park supported the proposed budget, adding that operational efficiency gains could offset a portion of the increased technology spend.

DECISION: The board approved the 2025 operating budget with a $17.4 million revenue target, a $300,000 increase in technology infrastructure spend, and a 5% contingency reserve. A formal budget document to be circulated by January 20, 2025.

---

AGENDA ITEM 3: NORTHWIND PARTNERS — ACCOUNT STATUS AND STRATEGIC EXPANSION

Margaret Holvan introduced the agenda item concerning Northwind Partners, one of Marbledock & Associates' most significant clients. Holvan summarized that Northwind Partners had formally expressed interest in expanding their engagement with the firm, requesting advisory services across two additional business units: their European logistics arm and their newly established sustainability division.

Aiyana Park provided an operational assessment, noting that the current team assigned to the Northwind Partners account has capacity to absorb approximately 40% of the projected additional workload. She recommended hiring one senior consultant and one junior analyst specifically to support the expanded scope, with onboarding targeted for March 2025.

Pierre Dubois presented a preliminary financial projection for the expanded Northwind Partners contract, estimating additional annual revenue of $980,000 if both new service lines are confirmed. He noted that contract terms should include a minimum 12-month commitment clause to protect revenue predictability.

Margaret Holvan confirmed that a follow-up meeting with Northwind Partners leadership had been tentatively scheduled for January 22, 2025, to present a formal proposal.

DECISION: The board approved pursuing the expanded engagement with Northwind Partners. Aiyana Park is authorized to initiate recruitment for one senior consultant and one junior analyst. Pierre Dubois is to finalize a contract proposal including a minimum 12-month commitment clause, to be ready for the January 22 client meeting. Margaret Holvan will lead the client presentation.

---

AGENDA ITEM 4: DIGITAL TRANSFORMATION ROADMAP — PHASE 2 UPDATE

Aiyana Park presented an update on the Phase 2 digital transformation initiative, which began in September 2024. Key milestones completed include the migration of internal project management systems to the new cloud-based platform and the rollout of the updated client reporting portal to 80% of active accounts.

Remaining Phase 2 deliverables include full deployment of the client portal to all accounts by February 28, 2025, and integration of the new CRM system with existing billing software, targeted for completion by March 31, 2025. Park noted that the CRM integration had experienced a two-week delay due to vendor-side API issues, which have since been resolved.

DECISION: The board acknowledged the Phase 2 progress and reaffirmed the revised deadlines: full client portal deployment by February 28, 2025, and CRM-billing integration by March 31, 2025. Aiyana Park to provide a written status update at the next board meeting.

---

AGENDA ITEM 5: HUMAN RESOURCES — COMPENSATION REVIEW AND RETENTION STRATEGY

Margaret Holvan raised the topic of staff retention, noting that two senior team members had departed in Q4 2024 and that the competitive talent market required a proactive compensation strategy. Pierre Dubois presented data benchmarking Marbledock & Associates' current salary bands against industry averages, identifying a 6–9% gap at the senior associate and manager levels.

The board discussed the feasibility of a targeted compensation adjustment within the approved 2025 budget. Dubois confirmed that a 7% average salary increase for senior associates and managers could be accommodated without exceeding the contingency reserve, provided it is implemented from April 1, 2025.

Additionally, Aiyana Park proposed introducing a performance-based retention bonus for employees completing three or more years of service, to be awarded annually in December.

DECISION: The board approved a 7% salary adjustment for senior associates and managers, effective April 1, 2025. The retention bonus program proposed by Aiyana Park is approved in principle; Pierre Dubois and Aiyana Park to co-develop a detailed program framework for board review by February 15, 2025.

---

AGENDA ITEM 6: ANY OTHER BUSINESS AND NEXT MEETING DATE

Margaret Holvan reminded the board that the annual client appreciation event is scheduled for March 14, 2025, and requested that all leadership confirm attendance and submit guest nominations by January 31, 2025. Aiyana Park confirmed that venue arrangements are already underway.

Pierre Dubois raised a brief note regarding the renewal of the firm's professional liability insurance policy, due February 28, 2025. He will handle the renewal process and report back if any material changes to coverage or premiums arise.

The next board meeting was set for February 9, 2025, at 9:00 AM in the Executive Conference Room.

DECISION: All board members to submit client appreciation event guest nominations by January 31, 2025. Pierre Dubois to manage insurance policy renewal and report any material changes. Next board meeting confirmed for February 9, 2025.

---

Meeting adjourned at 11:45 AM.

Minutes recorded by: Clara Sievert, Executive Assistant
Approved by: Margaret Holvan, CEO
